claim: FSSAI is the sole regulatory authority for nutraceuticals in India, covering dietary supplements, functional foods, herbal/ayurvedic nutraceuticals, probiotics, sports nutrition, and medical foods.
stance_target: FSSAI (not CDSCO) is the primary body that Indian supplement brands like Briyo must register with
scope_conditions: India, standard nutraceutical and health supplement products
quoted_support: In India, nutraceuticals fall under FSSAI. The same authority that handles food safety also covers these products. So when you apply for registration, most of the rules you'll be dealing with are from FSSAI itself.

claim: FSSAI advertisement and claims approval for food supplements and nutraceuticals costs Rs. 50,000 (dossier fee) and takes approximately 1 to 8 days.
stance_target: FSSAI claims approval process is relatively fast but involves a substantial fee
scope_conditions: India, FSSAI advertisement and claims approval for nutraceuticals
quoted_support: Applicants should furnish a dossier with a complete application form and government fees of Rs. 50,000. The Food Authority will convene an expert committee for preliminary scrutiny and claim approval. The timeline for obtaining the FSSAI Advertisement & Claims Approval for Food Supplements & Nutraceuticals is approximately one to eight days.

claim: Nutraceuticals can make health claims in India if supported by scientific data, and clinical trials are not mandatory unless health claims are being made.
stance_target: FSSAI does not require clinical trials for all nutraceuticals, only for those making specific health claims
quoted_support: Can nutraceuticals in India make health claims? Yes, a nutraceutical can make health claims if it has scientific data to prove it. Do nutraceuticals require clinical trials conduction? No, it is not mandatory for the nutraceuticals to carry clinical trials. However, if the nutraceutical makes any health claims the FSSAI requires clinical data to prove it.

claim: FSSAI monitors the nutraceutical market for safety issues, misleading claims, and non-compliance, and takes corrective action including license cancellation, fines, product recall, and imprisonment.
stance_target: FSSAI actively enforces regulations; a visible FSSAI license number on a product provides meaningful consumer assurance
quoted_support: FSSAI non-compliance leads to penalties such as license cancellation, fines, recall, imprisonment of the products, etc.
